statement:
For a separated finite-type scheme $U/k$, a bounded coherent complex $K$, and an open compactification $j:U\hookrightarrow X$ with $X$ proper over $k$, choose any Deligne system $(K_n)$ extending $K$. Define *compactly supported coherent cohomology* $H^i_c(U,K)=\varprojlim_n H^i(X,K_n)$, a topological $k$-vector space with the projective-limit topology of finite-dimensional discrete $k$-vector spaces. This is independent of compactification and Deligne representative up to its canonical pro-identifications. For an arbitrary $k$-vector space $V$, give its full linear dual $V^\vee=\operatorname{Hom}_k(V,k)$ the limit topology over the finite-dimensional subspaces of $V$, discrete on each finite-dimensional dual. For a separated finite-type morphism $p:U\to\operatorname{Spec}k$, write $\omega^\bullet_{U/k}=p^!k$, where $p^!$ is the upper-shriek functor built using a proper compactification. For every $K\in D_{\mathrm{Coh}}^b(\mathcal O_U)$ and $i\in\mathbf Z$ there is a *canonical functorial isomorphism of topological $k$-vector spaces*
\[
\operatorname{Hom}_k(H^i(U,K),k)\xrightarrow{\sim}
H_c^{-i}\!\left(U,R\mathcal Hom_{\mathcal O_U}(K,\omega^\bullet_{U/k})\right).
\]
The left dual has the weak inverse-limit topology above, not the unrestricted discrete topology when $H^i(U,K)$ is infinite-dimensional. The cohomology on the right is computed using coherent pro-extension, not classical étale cohomology with compact supports.
hypotheses: k field, U separated finite type over k, bounded coherent K, dualizing ω=p^!k and both projective-limit topologies.
conclusions: Compactly supported coherent duality as a natural topological vector-space isomorphism.
original_source_statement_tex:
\label{lemma-duality-compact-support}
Let $p : U \to \Spec(k)$ be separated of finite type where $k$ is a field.
Let $\omega_{U/k}^\bullet = p^!\mathcal{O}_{\Spec(k)}$.
There are canonical isomorphisms
$$
\Hom_k(H^i(U, K), k) =
H^{-i}_c(U, R\SheafHom_{\mathcal{O}_U}(K, \omega_{U/k}^\bullet))
$$
of topological $k$-vector spaces
functorial for $K$ in $D^b_{\textit{Coh}}(\mathcal{O}_U)$.

statement:
For a separated finite-type scheme $U/k$, a bounded coherent complex $K$, and an open compactification $j:U\hookrightarrow X$ with $X$ proper over $k$, choose any Deligne system $(K_n)$ extending $K$. Define *compactly supported coherent cohomology* $H^i_c(U,K)=\varprojlim_n H^i(X,K_n)$, a topological $k$-vector space with the projective-limit topology of finite-dimensional discrete $k$-vector spaces. This is independent of compactification and Deligne representative up to its canonical pro-identifications. For an arbitrary $k$-vector space $V$, give its full linear dual $V^\vee=\operatorname{Hom}_k(V,k)$ the limit topology over the finite-dimensional subspaces of $V$, discrete on each finite-dimensional dual. For a separated finite-type morphism $p:U\to\operatorname{Spec}k$, write $\omega^\bullet_{U/k}=p^!k$, where $p^!$ is the upper-shriek functor built using a proper compactification. Let $U'\hookrightarrow U$ be an open subscheme of a separated finite-type $k$-scheme, $K\in D_{\mathrm{Coh}}^b(\mathcal O_U)$, and $K'=K|_{U'}$. Write $D_U=R\mathcal Hom_U(K,\omega^\bullet_{U/k})$, so $D_U|_{U'}\simeq R\mathcal Hom_{U'}(K',\omega^\bullet_{U'/k})$. Then the square
\[
\begin{matrix}
\operatorname{Hom}_k(H^i(U,K),k)&\xrightarrow{\sim}&H^{-i}_c(U,D_U)\\
\uparrow&&\uparrow\\
\operatorname{Hom}_k(H^i(U',K'),k)&\xrightarrow{\sim}&H^{-i}_c(U',D_U|_{U'})
\end{matrix}
\]
commutes, where the left upward arrow is the *linear dual of restriction* $H^i(U,K)\to H^i(U',K')$ and the right upward arrow is the *covariant open-immersion* map for compactly supported pro-cohomology. Both horizontal maps are the natural topological duality isomorphisms.
hypotheses: U' open in U separated finite type/k, K bounded coherent, compact duality as defined.
conclusions: Naturality square comparing restriction dual with covariant compact-support maps commutes.
original_source_statement_tex:
\label{lemma-duality-compact-support-restrict-open}
With notation as in Lemma \ref{lemma-duality-compact-support}
suppose $U' \subset U$ is an open subscheme. Then the diagram
$$
\xymatrix{
\Hom_k(H^i(U, K), k) \ar[rr] & &
H^{-i}_c(U, R\SheafHom_{\mathcal{O}_U}(K, \omega_{U/k}^\bullet)) \\
\Hom_k(H^i(U', K|_{U'}), k) \ar[rr] \ar[u] & &
H^{-i}_c(U', R\SheafHom_{\mathcal{O}_{U'}}(K, \omega_{U'/k}^\bullet)) \ar[u]
}
$$
is commutative. Here the horizontal arrows are the isomorphisms of
Lemma \ref{lemma-duality-compact-support}, the vertical arrow on the
left is the contragredient to the restriction map
$H^i(U, K) \to H^i(U', K|_{U'})$, and the right vertical arrow
is Remark \ref{remark-covariance-open-lower-shriek} (see discussion
before the lemma).
